startup: cd /home/container; if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE,,}" = "true" ]; then if [ -x /home/container/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then /home/container/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update 2208380 validate +quit; else echo "[startup] SteamCMD was not found; skipping automatic update."; fi; fi; if [ -d "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config" ] && [ ! -d DeadPoly/Saved/Config ]; then mkdir -p DeadPoly/Saved/Config; cp -a "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/." DeadPoly/Saved/Config/; fi; if [ -f deadpoly-config.sh ]; then bash deadpoly-config.sh; fi; mkdir -p mods; if [ -f deadpoly-update-monitor.sh ] && [ "${AUTO_UPDATE_CHECK,,}" = "true" ]; then bash deadpoly-update-monitor.sh & fi; if [ -f DeadPolyServer.exe ]; then wine DeadPolyServer.exe -log -nosteam -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -queryport={{QUERY_PORT}} -maxplayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} {{EXTRA_ARGS}}; else wine DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe -log -nosteam -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -queryport={{QUERY_PORT}} -maxplayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} {{EXTRA_ARGS}}; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# DeadPoly dedicated-server installation for Pterodactyl
# Egg version: 1.0.0
# Maintainer: Azzy-tm
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 unzip

# Install SteamCMD inside the persistent server directory so the Wine runtime
# container can use it for startup updates and update monitoring.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steamcmd
if [ ! -x /mnt/server/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/.steamcmd
fi
STEAMCMD=/mnt/server/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh

if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE,,}" = "true" ] || { [ ! -f DeadPolyServer.exe ] && [ ! -f DeadPoly/Binaries/Win64/DeadPolyServer.exe ]; }; then
    "$STEAMCMD" +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 2208380 validate +quit
fi

if [ -d "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config" ] && [ ! -d DeadPoly/Saved/Config ]; then
    mkdir -p DeadPoly/Saved/Config
    cp -a "DeadPoly/Saved/1 RENAME Config/." DeadPoly/Saved/Config/
fi

mkdir -p DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer
if [ ! -f DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini ]; then
    cat > DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini <<'EOF'
[Server]
servername=DeadPoly Server
maxplayers=16
Private=False

[Admins]
Admin="YOUR_TRUST_MENU_ID"

[Allowed]
Allow="FRIEND_TRUST_MENU_ID"
EOF
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods

if [ -n "$MODS_URL" ] && [ "${MODS_AUTO_EXTRACT,,}" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Downloading DeadPoly mod archive..."
    curl -fL "$MODS_URL" -o /tmp/deadpoly-mods.zip
    mkdir -p /tmp/deadpoly-mods
    unzip -q -o /tmp/deadpoly-mods.zip -d /tmp/deadpoly-mods
    cp -a /tmp/deadpoly-mods/. /mnt/server/mods/
    echo "Mods extracted to /mnt/server/mods."
fi

cat > /mnt/server/deadpoly-config.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
INI="DeadPoly/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Game.ini"
[ -f "$INI" ] || exit 0

set_kv() {
    local key="$1" value="$2"
    if grep -qi "^${key}=" "$INI"; then
        sed -i "s/^${key}=.*/${key}=${value}/I" "$INI"
    else
        printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$value" >> "$INI"
    fi
}

set_kv servername "$SERVER_NAME"
set_kv maxplayers "$MAX_PLAYERS"
set_kv Private "$PRIVATE"

write_ids() {
    local section="$1" key="$2" csv="$3"
    awk -v section="$section" -v key="$key" -v csv="$csv" '
        BEGIN { insec=0; wrote=0 }
        $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*\\[" section "\\]" { insec=1; print; next }
        /^[[:space:]]*\[/ { if (insec && !wrote && csv != "") { print key "=\"" csv "\""; wrote=1 } insec=0; print; next }
        { if (insec && $0 ~ "^[[:space:]]*" key "=") next; print }
        END { if (insec && !wrote && csv != "") print key "=\"" csv "\"" }
    ' "$INI" > "$INI.tmp" && mv "$INI.tmp" "$INI"
}

write_ids Admins Admin "$ADMIN_IDS"
write_ids Allowed Allow "$ALLOWED_IDS"
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/deadpoly-config.sh

cat > /mnt/server/deadpoly-update-monitor.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Checks Steam for a newer DeadPoly dedicated-server build and restarts via Pterodactyl.
[ "${AUTO_UPDATE_CHECK,,}" = "true" ] || exit 0
[ -n "$PANEL_URL" ] || { echo "[update-monitor] PANEL_URL is not set; automatic update restart disabled."; exit 0; }
[ -n "$PTERO_API_KEY" ] || { echo "[update-monitor] PTERO_API_KEY is not set; automatic update restart disabled."; exit 0; }
[ -n "$SERVER_UUID" ] || { echo "[update-monitor] SERVER_UUID is not available; automatic update restart disabled."; exit 0; }

STEAMCMD="/home/container/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
[ -x "$STEAMCMD" ] || { echo "[update-monitor] SteamCMD was not found at $STEAMCMD; automatic update checking disabled."; exit 0; }

INTERVAL=$(( ${UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL:-60} * 60 ))

get_build() {
    "$STEAMCMD" +login anonymous +app_info_update 2208380 +app_info_print 2208380 +quit 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -A5 '"2208380"' \
        | grep -oP '"buildid"\s+"\K[0-9]+' \
        | head -n1
}

CURRENT_BUILD=$(get_build || true)
if [ -z "$CURRENT_BUILD" ]; then
    echo "[update-monitor] Could not read the current Steam build ID; retrying next cycle."
fi
echo "[update-monitor] Monitoring DeadPoly app 2208380; current build: ${CURRENT_BUILD:-unknown}"

while true; do
    sleep "$INTERVAL"
    NEW_BUILD=$(get_build || true)

    if [ -z "$NEW_BUILD" ]; then
        echo "[update-monitor] Update check failed; will retry."
        continue
    fi

    if [ -z "$CURRENT_BUILD" ]; then
        CURRENT_BUILD="$NEW_BUILD"
        echo "[update-monitor] Initialized known build as $CURRENT_BUILD"
        continue
    fi

    if [ "$NEW_BUILD" != "$CURRENT_BUILD" ]; then
        echo "[update-monitor] Update detected: $CURRENT_BUILD -> $NEW_BUILD"
        echo "[update-monitor] Requesting Pterodactyl server restart."

        HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/ptero-restart-response -w '%{http_code}' \
            -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTERO_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \
            --data '{"signal":"restart"}' \
            "${PANEL_URL%/}/api/client/servers/$SERVER_UUID/power" || true)

        echo "[update-monitor] Pterodactyl API response: HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
        if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "204" ]; then
            echo "[update-monitor] Restart requested successfully."
        else
            echo "[update-monitor] Restart request failed. Check PANEL_URL, API key permissions, and server identifier."
        fi
        exit 0
    else
        echo "[update-monitor] No update found; installed build $CURRENT_BUILD is current."
    fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/deadpoly-update-monitor.sh

echo "DeadPoly installation complete."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser. Avoid using / or & in the name.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous players.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Query/info port. Allocate this as a secondary port in Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Private Server
variables.description: Restrict joining to IDs in the allow list. True or False.

variables.name: Admin IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Trust-menu IDs with admin access.

variables.name: Allowed IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Trust-menu IDs allowed to join a private server.

variables.name: Blacklist IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Trust-menu IDs to blacklist. DeadPoly supports blacklisting through its dedicated-server configuration, but the exact Engine.ini ban format is not officially documented; use the in-game admin ban feature where possible or edit Engine.ini manually.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Run SteamCMD validation/update on every start. True or False.

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Optional extra DeadPolyServer.exe launch arguments.

variables.name: Update Check
variables.description: Check Steam for DeadPoly server updates while running. True or False. Keep AUTO_UPDATE=true, or create a panel scheduled task that runs the Update Server action before/after restarts. Otherwise, the server will restart repeatedly whenever Steam reports a new build.

variables.name: Update Check Interval
variables.description: Minutes between Steam update checks. Default is 60.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Base URL of this Pterodactyl panel, used for automatic restarts. Example: https://panel.example.com

variables.name: Pterodactyl API Key
variables.description: Client API key with Control permission for this server. Required only for automatic update restarts.

variables.name: Mods ZIP URL
variables.description: Optional direct URL to a .zip containing server mod files. Extracted into the mods/ folder during installation. Leave empty if not using mods.

variables.name: Extract Mods
variables.description: Extract the Mods ZIP URL into mods/ during installation. True or False.

variables.name: Steam Workshop Mods
variables.description: Currently unavailable: DeadPoly does not currently support server-side Steam Workshop mods.

variables.name: Zombie Spawn Rate
variables.description: Currently unavailable: zombie spawn rate is not configurable through DeadPoly's dedicated-server INI settings.

variables.name: Loot Spawn Rate
variables.description: Currently unavailable: loot/item respawn rate is not configurable through DeadPoly's dedicated-server INI settings.

variables.name: Sleeping
variables.description: Currently unavailable: sleeping is not configurable through DeadPoly's dedicated-server INI settings.

variables.name: Day Length
variables.description: Currently unavailable: day length is not configurable through DeadPoly's dedicated-server INI settings.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: Currently unavailable: difficulty is not configurable through DeadPoly's dedicated-server INI settings.

variables.name: Egg Version
variables.description: Internal version of this DeadPoly Pterodactyl egg. Do not edit.
